_source: US metro areas from the Census Bureau's CBSA delineation (OMB Bulletin 23-01, July 2023). A metro is the county's metropolitan division when its CBSA has divisions, else the CBSA (metropolitan or micropolitan). Every metro is listed. Every US place (incorporated or census-designated) in the Census place-by-county file is a row unless none of its counties is in a CBSA; rows are keyed by the place name without its type word (city, town, CDP, ...). When several places share a name, the principal reading is the one with the largest ACS 2018-2022 population, "metros" are the metros of that place's counties, and "also" lists the metros of the other places of that name. Generated by build_tables.py from the files below.
